map.本工具依据抗心律失常药 Vaughan-Williams 分类与电生理机制整理，: This tool organizes antiarrhythmic drugs by Vaughan-Williams class and electrophysiology, grouping them into I/II/III/IV and noting indications and contraindications; calculation runs locally in the browser, data is not uploaded, results are for reference only, specific medication is decided by a cardiology specialist.
map.提示：结构性心脏病(心梗/心衰/左室肥厚)患者禁用IC类(CAST研究)。胺碘酮: Note: IC class is contraindicated in structural heart disease (MI/heart failure/LVH) per the CAST trial. Amiodarone has multi-channel effects - classified III but with I/II/IV effects. Digoxin/adenosine are not in V-W but commonly used clinically. For clinical reference only.
map.Vaughan-Williams 四类查询：I 类钠通道阻滞（Ia 奎尼丁、Ib: Vaughan-Williams four-class query: Class I sodium block (Ia quinidine, Ib lidocaine, Ic propafenone/flecainide), Class II beta-block, Class III potassium (amiodarone/sotalol), Class IV calcium block (verapamil/diltiazem), grouped by electrophysiology.
map.房颤节律控制选药：无结构性心脏病优选 Ic 类（普罗帕酮）或 III 类；合并心: Drug choice for AF rhythm control: no structural disease prefers Ic (propafenone) or III; with heart failure or LVH avoid Ic (proarrhythmic), amiodarone often used; consider cardiac function and QT interval.
map.预激（WPW）伴房颤禁用 Ic 与维拉帕米：Ic 类可加快旁路传导、维拉帕米抑制: WPW with AF contraindicates Ic and verapamil: Ic speeds accessory pathway conduction, verapamil's AV-node suppression can let ventricular rate run away - both contraindicated; acute care prefers electrical cardioversion or ibutilide (in-hospital).
map.输入：胺碘酮。工具输出：分类 III 类（钾通道阻滞）、主要作用 延长动作电位时: Input: amiodarone. Output: Class III (potassium channel block), main effect prolongs action potential and refractory period, common use ventricular/atrial arrhythmias and AF sinus rhythm maintenance, key caution QT prolongation and thyroid/pulmonary toxicity need monitoring. Note: may be used cautiously in severe heart failure but requires specialist follow-up.
map.四类抗心律失常药核心区别？: What are the core differences among the four classes?
map.I 类阻断钠通道（按解离速度分 Ia/Ib/Ic），II 类阻断 β 受体，II: Class I blocks sodium (by dissociation speed Ia/Ib/Ic), II blocks beta-receptors, III prolongs repolarization (potassium), IV blocks L-type calcium. The class determines the arrhythmia type and proarrhythmic risk; selection must consider underlying heart disease.
map.为什么结构性心脏病要避免 Ic 类？: Why avoid Ic in structural heart disease?
map.Ic 类（普罗帕酮、氟卡尼）显著减慢传导，在缺血或心衰心肌可诱发持续性室速（CA: Ic (propafenone, flecainide) markedly slows conduction and can trigger sustained VT in ischemic or failing myocardium (CAST trial showed higher long-term mortality), so only for those without organic heart disease; with structural disease prefer amiodarone or catheter ablation.
map.抗心律失常药能自行调整吗？: Can antiarrhythmic drugs be adjusted by oneself?
map.不能。此类药治疗窗窄且有致心律失常风险，胺碘酮还影响甲状腺/肺/肝，索他洛尔受: No. These have a narrow therapeutic window and proarrhythmic risk; amiodarone also affects thyroid/lung/liver, sotalol is QT-limited. Any change should be under a cardiology specialist and with regular ECG and drug-level/function checks.
